seo.title: Kendwa Sunset Villa | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Private 2-bedroom villa on Kendwa beach with plunge pool, ocean views, and direct beach access. Perfect for couples or families. From $220/night.

content:
Kendwa Sunset Villa sits on the western shore of Zanzibar, directly facing the point where the sun drops into the Indian Ocean each evening in a display that has to be seen to be believed. This stylish two-bedroom villa offers the privacy and space of your own beach house with the convenience of a concierge who can arrange everything from boat trips to private dinners.

The villa’s open-plan design makes the most of its oceanfront position: floor-to-ceiling glass doors fold back to merge the living room with a shaded terrace and plunge pool, all facing the sea. Both bedrooms are generously sized with king beds, en-suite bathrooms, and private views of the garden or the ocean. The fully equipped kitchen is ideal for those who want to cook with fresh market ingredients, but most guests find it hard to resist the private chef option—imagine grilled prawns and passion-fruit sorbet served on your terrace as the sky turns pink. Kendwa’s famously tide-independent beach means you can swim at any hour, and the lively beach bar scene is just a short walk along the sand.
